On this page, I attempt to “pre-register” predictions by committing to making them publicly here. I assign each prediction a confidence level and a resolution date.^[Sometimes may be an approximate date.] As they resolve, I’ll come back and turn this into a scorecard! I’m committing to using this as an exercise to highlight my failures as well as my successes, and as part of this public exercise you can verify things via the page’s [change history](https://github.com/zacharylhertz/zacharylhertz.github.io/commits/main/predictions/predictions.yaml).

## All predictions

Click a column header to sort by that field. I have a [full predictions table](all.qmd) that includes what criteria are used for resolving predictions, as well as some short notes for/against each prediction. These are both my assessment of the general probabilities, and then my personal confidence in my own analysis, which I call *effort.* This should serve as a pseudo-weight on how much I would actually stand behind a call or be open to updating. A **quick take** is something I'm making on vibes or a gut check, **considered** generally means some amount of rough BOTECs without modeling, and **deep dives** are things I base on original analysis or modeling.
